links.outcome: Reading grade level of online patient education materials versus sixth-grade recommendation
links.effect: Average FKGL of OPEMs was 11.3, significantly greater than NIH/AMA sixth-grade recommendation (p < 0.001).
links.quote: The average Flesch-Kincaid grade level (FKGL) of OPEMs was 11.3, significantly greater than the NIH/AMA-sixth grade recommendations (p < 0.001).

links.outcome: Readability of patient materials after LLM plain-language rewriting, with accuracy and comprehensiveness ratings
links.effect: FKGL fell from 11.3 to 7.5 with ChatGPT and 5.6 with Gemini (p<0.001). ChatGPT accuracy 4.5/5 vs Gemini 4.0/5; comprehensiveness 2.0/3 vs 1.0/3.
links.quote: The average FKGL of ChatGPT rewrites was significantly lower than that of OPEMs (11.3 vs. 7.5, p < 0.001), as was the average FKGL of Gemini rewrites (11.3 vs. 5.6, p < 0.001).

unlisted_practices: Using LLMs to rewrite existing online patient education materials at a sixth-grade reading level
